title: Azusawa Kohane — A Sweet Moment〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Plaza

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Well, how was I?

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Don't hold back! I can take it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Then, I'll start with what stood out to me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Singing with you, I noticed you sang as if you were the lead vocalist.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. That concerned me a bit as well.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Uh, so you mean...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Singing solo and singing in a chorus are different beasts.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
If this were a solo performance, you'd want your individuality on full display...
But for a chorus, it's important to harmonize... To maintain a balance between all the performers.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Huh...?! D-Did I stand out that much?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah... Your voice really carries and all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you don't wanna stick out like a sore thumb, it looks like you'll have to listen to the rest of the group and adjust.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Oof! Y-You're telling me...

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: It's all MY fault our practice didn't go right?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...!
No, Memetchi, that's—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And what if it is?

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If it really is your fault, then everything's solved the second you get better.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So the real question is, what're you gonna do about it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't worry! You'll get the hang of the chorus style in no time, Memetchi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. As long as you're able to make a habit of listening to your groupmates, you should certainly improve.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're right, Memetchi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It might not have been right for a choir recital, but your singing just now was bursting with drive. I liked it a lot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, it's all about dialing things back when you need to while holding on to that feeling!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Bursting with drive...

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: There's no way I can let Makiko's group beat mine! I've gotta focus!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Look at me, totally spinning my wheels... All because I didn't want to lose to Makiko.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
...
Is this “Makiko” a rival of yours?

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Yes! Makiko's an important tama friend, and also my forever rival!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We totally know how you feel, not wanting to let your rival beat you.
Right, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Someone who's your most important partner...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The one person you can't lose to, because you have to stand by their side!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: To stand by Makiko's side, I can't lose...

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Yeah! That's exactly how I feel!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Everyone's hearts have become one. Now...)

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Alright, team! Until I get the hang of this, you're all stuck with me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An, Akito & Toya
rows.Line:
No problem!
Sure thing.
Of course.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I'm not sure I've ever...sang for this long before...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Great job, Memetchi! It was amazing to hear you keep improving each time!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: It's because you're all such good teachers!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Also, it's really nice feeling like our voices are bringing us together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Totally! I hope your recital with your friends goes just as great!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I'd love to practice with them right now!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Wait... Did you all hear someone singing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I can't say I did...

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Oh, hold on, there it is again!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: I know this voice... It's Mametchi! And I hear someone else too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe they're calling for you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's possible. I imagine the thought process is that if you got led here by song, you can be called over in the same way.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Then, if I sing, will Mametchi hear me too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure your song will breach the distance. Not only that, it should guide you on your way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's great, Memetchi! You get to see your friend!

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Yeah! I actually had no clue how I was gonna get home, so this is good news!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But that means we've gotta say goodbye, huh...

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: No... There's still so much I wanna talk to you all about.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Memetchi...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Memetchi, you have to go see your friend!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sure Mametchi's worried about you. And...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You have to get back home and show your rival you won't lose!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She's right. You even spent all that time practicing for your recital.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Show 'em what you've got. You, and your team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As your friends, we wish you success.

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Kohane... All of you...

rows.Speaker: Memetchi
rows.Line: Right! I'll go to where Mametchi is!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's sing together one last time to say goodbye!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're going all out and leaving no regrets!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Memetchi
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh... That light...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This really is goodbye...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've gotta sing my heart out to the very end! I won't let this moment be sad for Memetchi!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Memetchi's gone...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Chin up, Kohane. I doubt this is the last time you'll see each other.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. Memetchi made a real bond with you all.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That bond will allow you all to meet again someday... Wouldn't you rather believe that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It was so much fun spending time with you, Memetchi...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'll miss you, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (When the chance comes... Let's all sing together again!)
